subject: English
text: How much money was the postmaster able to collect and send to Lencho in 'A Letter to God'?
explanation: The postmaster was able to collect only seventy pesos, which was a little more than half of the hundred pesos Lencho had requested.

subject: English
text: Who accompanied Nelson Mandela on the stage on the day of the South African democratic inauguration?
explanation: Nelson Mandela was accompanied on stage by his daughter, Zenani.

subject: English
text: Who is the author of the story 'A Triumph of Surgery'?
explanation: James Herriot, a veterinary surgeon, is the author of 'A Triumph of Surgery' and the narrator of the story.

subject: English
text: In the poem 'A Tiger in the Zoo', what material is the tiger's cell made of?
explanation: The poet mentions that the tiger is locked inside a 'concrete cell' where his strength is confined behind bars.

subject: English
text: How old was the thief narrator (Hari Singh) in the story 'The Thief's Story'?
explanation: Hari Singh narrates the story, mentioning that he was only fifteen years old when he met Anil.

subject: English
text: Fill in the blank with the correct determiner: There is ________ hope of his survival as he is in critical condition.
explanation: 'Little' carries a negative sense implying almost no hope, which fits a critical medical condition.

subject: English
text: In 'From the Diary of Anne Frank', when did Anne's grandmother pass away?
explanation: Anne Frank's grandmother fell ill in the summer of 1941 and died in January 1942.

subject: English
text: What was the call sign of the narrator's old Dakota plane in 'The Black Aeroplane'?
explanation: The narrator was flying his old Dakota plane with call sign 'DS 088' and contacted Paris Control using it.

subject: English
text: In the poem 'How to Tell Wild Animals', which animal is described as giving a 'very, very hard' hug?
explanation: The poet jokingly describes the Bear as an animal that hugs a person very tightly when they meet him in a yard.

subject: English
text: Choose the correct indirect form of: The captain said to the soldiers, 'Stand at ease!'
explanation: Commands given by military officers are reported using 'ordered' or 'commanded' followed by infinitive 'to stand'.

options.text: The captain ordered the soldiers to stand at ease.
The captain ordered the soldiers that they stood at ease.
The captain advised the soldiers to standing at ease.
The captain requested the soldiers to stand at ease.

subject: English
text: What accent did Ausable speak with in the story 'The Midnight Visitor'?
explanation: Ausable spoke French and German passably but had a strong American accent that he brought from Boston twenty years ago.

subject: English
text: During which hours did Valli's mother typically take her afternoon nap?
explanation: Valli's mother slept every afternoon from about one o'clock to four o'clock, which Valli used for her excursions.

subject: English
text: Fill in the blank with the correct form of the verb: The quality of these mangoes ________ not good.
explanation: The subject is 'quality' (singular noun), not 'mangoes'. Therefore, it requires a singular verb ('is').

subject: English
text: In 'A Question of Trust', how did Horace Danby manage to buy the rare and expensive books he loved?
explanation: Horace used an agent to buy books secretly, funding them with money stolen during his annual safe robberies.

options.text: Through a secret agent who bought them for him.
By bidding in international public auctions.
By writing book reviews for local magazines.
By trading his handmade lock parts with publishers.

subject: English
text: In 'The Ball Poem', what valuable life lesson is the young boy learning through the loss of his ball?
explanation: The boy is learning the 'epistemology of loss'—how to accept loss, bear the grief, and stand up to survive in a materialist world.

options.text: How to bear the grief of losing a valued possession and move on.
How to save money to buy expensive toys in the future.
How to play games without losing his focus.
How to complain to police about lost properties.

subject: English
text: Richard Ebright won first prize in the county science fair for a project showing:
explanation: Ebright won first prize by carrying out research to identify if a beetle was the carrier of a viral disease killing monarch caterpillars.

options.text: A beetle was the cause of viral disease killing monarch caterpillars.
DNA structure has a double helix spiral.
Viceroy butterflies copy monarch butterflies to survive.
Gold spots on pupae contain cell hormones.

subject: English
text: Fill in the blank with the appropriate modal verb: We ________ respect our national flag and constitution.
explanation: 'Ought to' is used to express moral obligation, duty, or social responsibility, which fits national duties.

subject: English
text: In 'The Necklace', how much money did M. Loisel spend to buy a new dress for his wife to wear to the minister's party?
explanation: M. Loisel gave Matilda four hundred francs, which he had saved to buy a gun to go shooting with friends.

subject: English
text: In 'The Proposal', what was the buying price of Lomov's hunting dog Guess?
explanation: Lomov mentions that he bought his dog Guess from Mironov for one hundred and twenty-five rubles.

subject: English
text: In the poem 'Amanda!', why does Amanda imagine herself as Rapunzel?
explanation: Amanda wants to live a life of absolute quiet and tranquility in a high tower where no one can bother or nag her, keeping her hair up forever.

options.text: To live a tranquil and rare life in a high tower, never letting down her hair.
To find a handsome prince who will rescue her from her mother.
Because she wants to grow very long and beautiful hair.
To hide her face from the village people.

subject: English
text: What was the occupation of Bholi's father, Ramlal?
explanation: Ramlal was a Numberdar (a local revenue collection official) in the village, representing the government.

options.text: A wealthy landlord and grain merchant
The school headmaster of the primary school
A farmer with large crop fields

subject: English
text: What is the Kaveri river's connection to the Coorg district in 'Glimpses of India'?
explanation: The Kaveri, a major river, obtains its fresh water from the hills and rainforests of Coorg.

options.text: It obtains its water from the hills and forests of Coorg.
It flows along the northern border of Coorg separating it from Mysore.
Its origin lies in the coffee plantations of Coorg.
It is dry in Coorg and flows only during monsoon.

subject: English
text: Choose the correct indirect form of: My mother said to me, 'Did you complete your homework?'
explanation: Interrogative sentences in simple past ('did you complete') shift to past perfect ('had completed') and helping verb questions use 'if' or 'whether'.

options.text: My mother asked me if I had completed my homework.
My mother asked me that if I completed my homework.
My mother inquired me if had I completed my homework.
My mother told me if I had completed my homework.

subject: English
text: In the poem 'The Tale of Custard the Dragon', what physical features of the pirate are described?
explanation: The pirate held a pistol in each hand, a cutlass in his teeth, his beard was black, and one of his legs was wood.

options.text: Black beard, one wooden leg, a cutlass in his teeth, and pistols in hands.
A red coat, a patch on his eye, and carrying a large iron shield.
Tall height, curly hair, and wearing leather boots.
A hook for a hand, and carrying a wooden compass.

subject: English
text: In 'The Book That Saved the Earth', what shape is Think-Tank's head compared to?
explanation: Think-Tank is depicted as having a huge, egg-shaped head, which he believes contains a massive brain.
